journey.name: Pantry - Add and Delete Ingredients
journey.description: Test Pantry tab: verify add ingredient form, add a new ingredient, verify it appears in the list, swipe to delete it

actions.action: Tap the "Pantry" tab at the bottom of the screen
Verify the "My Pantry" title is visible
Verify the "Add Ingredient" form is visible with input fields for name, quantity, and unit
Tap the "Ingredient name" input field and type "Tomatoes"
Tap the "Quantity" input field and type "5"
Tap the "Unit" input field and type "unit"
Verify "Tomatoes" appears in the pantry list below the form
Swipe left on the "Tomatoes" pantry item to reveal the delete option
Verify "Tomatoes" is no longer visible in the pantry list
